annotations.title: Is demand for this brand durable?

description: Use when the user is checking a consumer target’s growth story in diligence, or asks whether a brand’s momentum will last: "is Celsius still gaining on Monster?", "is this brand a fad?". Runs share-of-search against the rivals you name and fad-check on the brand, and returns both readings with a combined label: durable, at risk, or mixed when they disagree. Each part keeps its own controls; if either refuses, nothing is charged. Every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. Calling this tool returns a quote, not the result: what the run measures, its price and a payment_url. The run happens only when you POST to payment_url, and a run that fails its controls refuses there with nothing charged. Price: $0.11 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $0.50 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token); charged only when the run comes back sound. For share of search alone, use run_share_of_search; for the fad reading alone, use run_fad_check.
